Productive Playhouse

SMS Data Collector - English (Nigeria)

Posted 2026-10-22
View application options
Work Type
Remote
Location
Nigeria
Compensation
$1.50 USD per qualified message

About this opportunity

Overview

Productive Playhouse is seeking English-speaking participants in Nigeria for a short-term, project-based mobile messaging data collection opportunity. The work is remote and flexible, and participants are paid for qualified SMS messages submitted from their own mobile phones.

What You'll Do

  • Submit authentic SMS messages received on your personal mobile phone that meet the project guidelines.
  • Label each eligible message as either scam or spam.
  • Classify submissions according to the required message type.
  • Make sure every submission is complete, accurate, and compliant with the project instructions.
  • Follow all submission and quality requirements for the project.

Requirements

  • Must be based in Nigeria.
  • Native or expert-level English fluency as spoken in Nigeria.
  • Access to your own mobile phone.
  • Access to your own Nigeria phone number.
  • Ability to follow project guidelines and quality standards.

Important Notes

  • Only SMS messages received directly on your mobile phone are eligible.
  • Messages collected from email or other platforms are not eligible.
  • Only submissions that meet the project requirements will be paid.
  • All engagements are contingent on successful identity verification.

Skills & expertise

SMS Data Collection Data Labeling Content Labeling Content Moderation English Fluency Mobile Device Use Quality Assurance
